jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Role Overview 

We are seeking a strategic, results-oriented Solution Marketing Campaign Director to partner with our VP of Solution Marketing and drive the campaign function for ServiceNow’s Employee Experience portfolio, connecting full-funnel awareness-to-demand strategy to delivery across the Employee Experience space. The Employee Experience business at ServiceNow is on an explosive growth trajectory and this individual will be at the center of driving ambitious targets. This individual contributor role ensures seamless integration across teams and regions for Employee Experience program campaigns, drives alignment across diverse stakeholders, and sets the standard for how these campaigns are planned, governed, and measured. The ideal candidate is a campaign expert who understands the end-to-end lifecycle of integrated marketing programs, influences through expertise, and brings cross-functional organizations along to deliver impactful, measurable results. 

Campaign Strategy & Execution 

  • Partner with the VP of Solution Marketing to shape and deliver integrated marketing campaign strategy for Employee Experience aligned to business priorities, program objectives, and persona-driven go-to-market plans 
  • Serve as the senior subject matter expert on Employee Experience campaign development and delivery, ensuring all touchpoints deliver a cohesive buyer experience across channels and regions 
  • Own campaign planning frameworks and governance for Employee Experience, including goals, expected outcomes, budgets, timelines, and KPIs, integrating input from across marketing 
  • Set quality standards and ensure Employee Experience campaigns deliver exceptional work that meets brand standards and in-market goals across regions 
  • Guide and mentor campaign managers and cross-functional partners, sharing best practices and building capability across the team 
  • Partner with Program Management & Operations to align Employee Experience campaign timelines with program milestones and resource plans 

Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence 

  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships across marketing, sales, product, and other ServiceNow organizations to align on shared goals and drive decisions in the Employee Experience space

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
To be successful in this role you have:

Experience & Skills 

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing campaign planning and delivery, with at least 3 years of experience driving campaigns at a senior, cross-functional level, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology with exposure to HR and IT audiences 
  • Proven track record leading complex, multi-channel campaigns with multiple stakeholders and significant budgets, including launches targeting buyers and line-of-business leaders 
  • Deep familiarity with full-funnel marketing across digital, email, content, and field marketing, applied to buying journeys 
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional campaign work, influence without direct authority, and build capability across teams supporting go-to-market 
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and balance strategic direction with operational excellence 

 

Personal Attributes 

  • Business outcome obsessed and motivated by ambitious goals 
  • Functional understanding of AI-native campaigns, including how AI reshapes campaign planning, content production, audience targeting, and performance optimization, and a drive to build and apply these capabilities in practice 
  • Highly collaborative professional with excellent communication, influence, and interpersonal skills 
  • Results-oriented, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to high-quality work that meets brand standards 
  • Strategic thinker who can connect tactical execution to long-term business objectives 
  • Eager to learn, grow, and drive change in a fast-paced marketing organization 

 

JV20

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $184,100 - $322,200, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
